The problem this solution exists for
IVR trees deflect; context dies at transfer; compliance transcript duties unmet; cost per contact climbs while CSAT falls.
Our approach

We rebuild conversational operations: grounded voice/chat agents resolving top intents, emotion-aware escalation with context handoff, agent-assist summarization, and resolution analytics steering the operating model.

items: Real-time context, summaries and next steps

blocks.x: Platform stack
The solution runs on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus: Many agents operating as one governed, measurable workforce. Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision.

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & Consumer Goods. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

Delivery runs on one weekly rhythm for every program of this type. The first quarter of the rhythm is verification: weeks 1–2 measure the current metric with your team and lock it by signature. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with your control owner receiving evidence weekly. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and the measured delta against the signed baseline. Gates are binding: miss one and the program stops or redirects with a documented decision.
